column1: # Prompt-injection patterns: the one list both scanners use (Python reads it; Rust compiles it in).
# Format: scope<TAB>reason<TAB>regex. scope 'any' = questions and documents; 'document' = documents only.
# Regexes run case-insensitively on text with accents and invisible characters removed, so write them
# without accents. Use syntax both Python re and Rust regex accept: no lookaround, no backreferences.
# Match phrases, never single verbs: a false positive silently drops a legitimate document chunk.
